panels.title: Every extracted document: id, text, extracted skills, confidence, review flag
panels.description: One row per real POST /extract call (app/extraction/models.py:ExtractionCall) — includes every document, not only flagged ones; use the "Show" variable above to narrow to needs_review only. matched_skills/unmatched_phrases are resolved from the stored match_detail/unmatched_detail JSONB (skill ids joined against the skills table for readability). mlflow_trace_id links out to that exact call's full trace (set MLFLOW_BASE_URL above to this environment's real MLflow host, default assumes local dev).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  ec.id,
  ec.called_at AS time,
  left(ec.text, 300) AS text_preview,
  ec.llm_model,
  ec.document_confidence,
  ec.needs_review,
  (ec.reviewed_at IS NOT NULL) AS reviewed,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT string_agg(s.name || ' (' || (m->>'confidence') || ')', ', ')
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(ec.match_detail) m
    JOIN skills s ON s.id = (m->>'skill_id')::int
  ), '') AS matched_skills,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT string_agg((u->>'phrase') || ' (' || COALESCE(u->>'best_score', 'n/a') || ')', ', ')
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(ec.unmatched_detail) u
  ), '') AS unmatched_phrases,
  ec.mlflow_trace_id
FROM extraction_calls ec
WHERE $__timeFilter(ec.called_at)
  AND ($needs_review_filter)
ORDER BY ec.called_at DESC
LIMIT 200

panels.title: Document count, flagged vs ok (selected range)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE needs_review) AS needs_review,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT needs_review) AS ok
FROM extraction_calls
WHERE $__timeFilter(called_at)

SELECT avg(document_confidence) AS avg_confidence
FROM extraction_calls
WHERE $__timeFilter(called_at)

SELECT count(*) AS open_backlog
FROM extraction_calls
WHERE needs_review AND reviewed_at IS NULL
